Comment: Tweak fog (fog effect), shake (earthquake effect), glitch (screen filter), waviness (terrain rounding), warping (terrain tremble), and the chat warning toggle.
BellsComment: Toggles the toll of a distant church bell during the approaching warning. It tolls once, twice, or three times for light, medium, or heavy storms to audibly indicate storm strength.
FunnyModeComment: When enabled, crank up glitch waviness and shake strength for a silly effect.
TemporalStormMusicComment: Play music during temporal storms that changes based on enemy proximity.
DetectRadiusComment: Distance (in blocks) from enemies to trigger combat music transition.
